title: Runtime Architecture: Product Creation and Discovery

components.name: Signed-in operator
components.responsibility: Chooses the Product name, event-store substrate, provider resource, and authorizes provider access.
components.multiplicity: One initiating operator per creation attempt
prohibited_authority: May not directly write canonical Product events
May not make Cloud directory data canonical

components.name: Hosted dashboard SPA
components.responsibility: Runs the staged creation experience including its embedded shared-backend connection step, preserves draft state, and renders discovery and recovery actions.
components.multiplicity: One or more browser sessions per operator
prohibited_authority: Must not infer event-store routing from current working directory

components.name: Bicameral Cloud
components.responsibility: Authenticates the operator and persists non-canonical Product directory publication.
components.authority_role: Identity authority for Cloud account and non-canonical directory writer
prohibited_authority: Must not write canonical Product settings or events
Must not receive provider tokens or local paths

components.name: Hosted local-daemon bridge
components.responsibility: Authenticates and transports typed browser-to-daemon commands without becoming Product authority.
components.multiplicity: One active paired session per browser/daemon pairing
prohibited_authority: Must not select an event store
Must not treat transport success as Product creation

components.name: Local Bicameral daemon
components.responsibility: Validates actor authority, provider/resource readiness, explicit Product routing, canonical creation, registration, and replay.
components.authority_role: Canonical Product command handler and local registration writer
components.multiplicity: One daemon may route many Products to many adapter instances
prohibited_authority: Must not use process current adapter when explicit Product routing is absent
Must not report Ready before registration and replay succeed

components.name: Operator connection service
components.responsibility: Starts provider authentication, stores secrets locally, and exposes non-secret operator-level readiness.
components.multiplicity: One operator registry with many provider connections
prohibited_authority: Must not become Product membership or event-store selection
Must not persist registry metadata under a Product workspace

components.name: GitHub or Google
components.responsibility: Authenticates the operator and authorizes access to a selected repository or Drive folder.
components.repository_runtime: GitHub OAuth/device flow or Google OAuth
components.multiplicity: One or more provider accounts and resources
prohibited_authority: Must not mint Bicameral Product identity
Must not receive Cloud membership or Decision Ledger data

components.name: Selected Product event store
components.responsibility: Persists canonical Product creation, settings, membership, and accepted events through the selected adapter.
components.process_boundary: Git repository or Drive folder adapter boundary
components.deployment_location: Selected GitHub repository or Google Drive folder
components.multiplicity: One explicitly addressed adapter/resource per Product; many per daemon
prohibited_authority: Must not be selected from working directory or an unrelated active adapter

relationships.interaction: Enter name, choose substrate/resource, and invoke create or recovery
relationships.handoff: Synchronous interaction with browser-local draft persistence

relationships.interaction: Read Cloud identity/directory and publish safe Product preview
relationships.handoff: Synchronous request over independently durable Cloud storage

relationships.interaction: Send typed connection, creation, and continuation commands
Deliver typed commands with daemon-confirmed actor context
relationships.handoff: Synchronous dispatch; idempotency survives transport retry

relationships.interaction: Check readiness and start/poll provider connection while retaining creation context
relationships.medium: Typed daemon API over hosted bridge
relationships.handoff: Asynchronous provider flow with resumable browser draft

relationships.interaction: Perform real OAuth/device flow and validate resource access
relationships.handoff: Asynchronous authorization with local secret persistence
authority_boundaries: Local secret boundary to external provider

relationships.interaction: Validate required operator connection and selected-resource access
authority_boundaries: Product command validation to credential metadata

relationships.interaction: Open explicitly addressed adapter, append CreateProduct, confirm provider-side remote durability, and replay canonical history
relationships.handoff: Durable append, provider-side read-back, and deterministic replay
authority_boundaries: Command authority to canonical persistence boundary

relationships.interaction: Persist and resolve ProductRegistration by Product id
authority_boundaries: Canonical Product identity to local routing state

states.persistence_location: Browser session storage keyed by Cloud account and creation attempt
states.lifecycle: Created on entry; retained across provider auth; deleted after durable registration or explicit cancel

states.artifact: Operator provider connection metadata and secret
states.persistence_location: Operator-global ~/.bicameral/connections.yaml plus approved local secret store
states.lifecycle: Absent, pending, connected, action_needed, or revoked independently of any Product

states.artifact: Canonical Product creation and membership history
states.persistence_location: Explicitly selected Git repository or Drive folder through EventStoreAdapter
states.routing_key: product_id mapped by explicit event-store descriptor
states.lifecycle: Minted once by idempotent CreateProduct; restored by replay

states.artifact: ProductCreationCommitProof for the exact CreateProduct event
states.persistence_location: Bounded daemon creation-operation receipt derived from provider-confirmed adapter response
states.routing_key: product_id plus creation attempt id plus event digest
states.mutation_path: Selected adapter provider confirmation followed by daemon proof normalization
states.lifecycle: Created once remote provider read-back confirms the exact event; reused for idempotent publication and recovery
May lag canonical creation and be retried independently
Pending until validated, registered while routable, repair_required when access is lost
prohibited_fallbacks: default Git registration without explicit selection

states.persistence_location: Ephemeral browser read model composed from Cloud publication and daemon readiness
states.mutation_path: Deterministic projection from Cloud membership, bridge, registration, and replay facts
states.lifecycle: available, needs_setup, ready, or repair_required as a Product-row projection; daemon unavailability exits this surface to pairing/reconnect

transitions.trigger: Required provider is absent and operator completes authorization
transitions.persistence_effect: Persist operator-global connection metadata/secret while retaining the browser draft

transitions.trigger: Operator confirms a valid Product name, selected resource, and ready connection
transitions.persistence_effect: Append exactly one idempotent CreateProduct event to the explicitly selected adapter

transitions.trigger: Selected adapter confirms the exact CreateProduct event at the selected provider resource
transitions.persistence_effect: Normalize the provider revision and exact-event digest into one safe ProductCreationCommitProof

transitions.trigger: A valid ProductCreationCommitProof authorizes publication of safe Product metadata
transitions.persistence_effect: Upsert non-canonical hosted directory publication keyed by Product id and proof digest

transitions.trigger: Canonical Product exists and explicit event-store descriptor remains accessible
Registered Product opens selected adapter and replay succeeds
transitions.persistence_effect: No new canonical state; render ready from observed registration and replay facts

transitions.trigger: Provider access, descriptor validation, or replay later fails
transitions.persistence_effect: Preserve canonical Product and registration; project repair_required with a safe retry action

scenarios.name: Create Product with an existing provider connection
scenarios.trigger: Operator opens Create Product and selects an accessible GitHub repository or Drive folder
scenarios.expected_result: Product is canonically created and provider-confirmed in the selected resource before Cloud publication, then appears Ready after registration and replay
scenarios.failure_behavior: Stop before canonical append on validation failure; after append but before provider confirmation forbid Cloud publication; after confirmation preserve Product/proof and expose an idempotent continuation

scenarios.name: Create Product requiring provider authorization
scenarios.trigger: Selected substrate requires a provider that is not connected
scenarios.expected_result: Real OAuth/device flow completes through the shared Connection service, the same embedded creation step resumes without Settings navigation, and resource validation becomes available
scenarios.failure_behavior: Denial, expiry, cancellation, or provider outage preserves the draft and exposes retry/change-provider/cancel without creating a Product

scenarios.name: Recover after canonical creation but before publication or registration
scenarios.trigger: Provider confirmation, Cloud publication, local registration, or replay fails after CreateProduct append
scenarios.expected_result: No Cloud row exists before first-event proof; afterward, while paired, the operator sees Needs setup with Continue setup until all post-create facts converge; lost pairing exits to pairing/reconnect
scenarios.failure_behavior: Reconstruct or reuse the original proof, then retry publication/registration by original Product id and idempotency keys; never append another CreateProduct

scenarios.name: Discover and open an existing Product
scenarios.trigger: Operator Home composes Cloud membership with daemon registration/readiness
scenarios.expected_result: Ready opens; absent registration exposes Continue setup; access/replay failure exposes Repair; lost daemon pairing leaves Operator Home for pairing/reconnect
scenarios.failure_behavior: Never render a Product row as Offline, replace unknown event-store details with GitHub defaults, or remove recovery actions

scenarios.name: Reject creation without explicit event-store routing
scenarios.trigger: A create request omits a validated event-store descriptor or attempts to use the daemon current adapter
scenarios.expected_result: Typed validation denial and no canonical event
scenarios.failure_behavior: No fallback to Git, current working directory, fixture adapter, or previously active Product

conformance.required_behavior: Render a dedicated staged creation surface with name, substrate, an embedded shared-backend GitHub/Google connection step, resource selection, review, and resumable recovery.
conformance.prohibited_fallback: Inline name-only registration card, navigation to Settings for required connection, duplicated OAuth state, or production use of dev SetupWizard.

validation_obligation.description: Browser component tests cover both providers, auth interruption, back navigation, and retained draft state.

implementation_evidence: Planned hosted Product creation UI slice

conformance.required_behavior: Resolve the adapter from a validated explicit descriptor before replay or append.
conformance.prohibited_fallback: Current adapter, current working directory, or default Git.

validation_obligation.description: Create two Products in distinct Git/Drive resources from one daemon and prove restart routes each Product correctly.

implementation_evidence: Current dispatch receives a preselected adapter and does not resolve Product routing

conformance.owner_module_or_seam: ProductCreateParams and hosted project registration orchestration
conformance.required_behavior: Carry selected provider, substrate, resource descriptor reference, and required capability into validated creation.
conformance.prohibited_fallback: Omitting supported hints or deriving them only after Cloud publication.

validation_obligation.description: Producer/consumer tests assert exact create payload, excluded secrets, and typed denial for missing routing.

implementation_evidence: ProductCreateParams supports event_store_hint and required_connection; browser create omits them

conformance.required_behavior: Invoke the implemented GitHub device flow and persist completion through the operator-global connection service.
conformance.prohibited_fallback: Fabricated session id or XXXX-XXXX user code.

validation_obligation.description: Provider-sandbox or controlled HTTP integration proves start, poll, denial, expiry, token persistence, and redacted responses.

implementation_evidence: github_device_flow module exists; connection_start returns a stub

conformance.owner_module_or_seam: gateway Google local-loopback OAuth and hosted UI orchestration
conformance.required_behavior: Start configured Google OAuth, preserve creation draft, process callback, and resume Drive resource selection.
conformance.prohibited_fallback: Fixture readiness or requiring the user to restart Product creation.

validation_obligation.description: Controlled OAuth integration covers success, missing config, denial, callback mismatch, and restart.

implementation_evidence: Google backend flow exists; hosted creation never invokes it

conformance.required_behavior: Read and write one operator-global registry and approved secret store independent of active workspace.

validation_obligation.description: Connect in one workspace, restart in another, and prove the same operator connection readiness without leaking secrets.

implementation_evidence: GET reads global registry while start/save prefer workspace-local registry

conformance.required_behavior: Project an absent registration as Needs setup with Continue setup; route any unpaired or unavailable daemon session to pairing/reconnect before Operator Home renders.
conformance.prohibited_fallback: Render a row-level Offline state or map an absent registration to a dead-end action.

validation_obligation.description: Truth-table tests cover membership, daemon reachability, registration, provider access, replay, label, and primary action independently.

implementation_evidence: Current tests assert unknown/unpaired binding maps to offline

conformance.required_behavior: Render unknown substrate/provider honestly until daemon registration supplies safe metadata.
conformance.prohibited_fallback: Hardcoded github event_store_kind and Cloud project label.

validation_obligation.description: Projection contract tests reject invented provider/substrate values and forbidden Cloud fields.

conformance.required_behavior: Persist commit-point receipts, reconstruct or reuse the first-event proof, and retry publication/registration without rerunning canonical creation.
conformance.prohibited_fallback: Generate a new Product id or append a second CreateProduct after partial success.

validation_obligation.description: Interrupt after each commit point, restart browser/daemon independently, and prove convergence with one CreateProduct event.

implementation_evidence: Create and publication idempotency exists; full browser lifecycle recovery remains incomplete

conformance.owner_module_or_seam: EventStoreAdapter append receipt and Product creation command
conformance.required_behavior: Confirm provider-side remote durability by revision plus exact-event read-back and return a schema_version 2 ProductCreationCommitProof whose digest hashes every field except proof_digest and signature (kid and signature_algorithm under the wax). event_digest is SHA-256 of serialize_event_store_entry bytes on Drive JSON append. The CreateProduct ledger EventStoreEntry has a protocol schema distinct from ProductCreationResult. v2 proofs are drive_folder only until Git appends those same bytes.
conformance.prohibited_fallback: Local file write, local Git commit, queued upload, request acceptance without durable revision, test receipt, dummy/probe write, v1 digest that excludes kid/alg, hashing ProductCreationResult instead of the ledger entry, or a Git v2 proof whose event_digest claims YAML-append bytes.

validation_obligation.description: Literal shared v2 canonical-bytes/digest/signature vector consumed by Bot and Cloud; onboarding fixture validator plus production-type round-trip for create-product-ledger-event; GitAdapter test proving YAML append is not serialize_event_store_entry JSON.

implementation_evidence: bot#1193: v2 canonical bytes + ledger event schema/fixture/validator mapping + shared golden vector. Hosted mint-on-create composition remains bot#1087. Git YAML-to-JSON migration is not this slice.

conformance.owner_module_or_seam: hosted Product creation orchestrator and Cloud publication client
conformance.required_behavior: Make every Cloud/Supabase Product publication impossible until a valid proof bound to the same Product, attempt, resource, and event digest exists.
conformance.prohibited_fallback: Optimistic Cloud row followed by eventual event-store persistence or accepting an unverified opaque creation receipt.

validation_obligation.description: Fault before remote confirmation and assert zero Cloud POSTs/rows; then confirm remote read-back and assert exactly one idempotent publication using the same proof digest.

implementation_evidence: Current hosted flow publishes before the real-process topology pushes canonical events to its disposable Git remote.

conformance.required_behavior: Exercise shipped SPA, Cloud, real daemon, operator registry, selected adapters, provider-confirmed first-event durability before Cloud publication, and real provider authorization boundaries.
conformance.prohibited_fallback: Fixtures, fabricated OAuth, in-memory substitutes, or component tests presented as journey acceptance.

validation_obligation.description: Browser lifecycle acceptance plus provider-edge evidence and deployed version confirmation.

implementation_evidence: Disposable remote Git can prove protocol ordering as supporting evidence; GitHub and Drive provider-edge confirmation remain incomplete.
